summary: Reference for ansible.module_utils.secrets, which provides functions to register secrets for masking in output and to mask strings manually.
questions: How can a custom module register a value so it is masked in Ansible output?
Which module_utils provides secret masking functions?

answer_card.title: Secret masking helpers for modules
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.module_utils.secrets` contains functions for registering secrets so Ansible masks them in output, and for masking strings manually. See the developing_secret_masking guide for usage.
